title: Space
subtitle: A bounded room where specialized agents work from a local instruction doc. Drafts wait for you.
createHelp: A Space is a name, a folder linked in place, and one instruction doc.
folderHelp: The folder is linked in place. Dream never copies it.
handoffHelp: Outcome, Sources, Constraints, Deliverable, Review point.
askHelp: Local briefing from the instruction doc. No hosted model is called here.
draftHelp: Natural-language rules stay pending until you approve. Nothing fires first.
